## GIL shared workflow

These rules apply to every GIL connection, with or without a Plugin, on every operating system.
Use only the user's selected absolute `project_root`. Each receipt's text guidance names **one next
call or one wait**; do it, then read the next receipt. Read `structuredContent` too, and follow the
actual recorded position and the connected tool schema. Never repeat a call that already succeeded.

1. **Start and show.** Start a new project once. After successful `gil_start`, follow its returned
   `show_gil_monitor` call before opening the first Interview step. Do not prepare the Monitor again
   if start returned its scope. Never repeat start to open a screen. If start succeeded but Monitor
   preparation failed, report the display failure and continue the recorded Interview via `gil_open`.
   A display failure alone does not block Project work. A successful tool response does not prove
   that a screen is visible. In a new session, read `gil_context` once; its first block
   `[지금 바로 할 호출]` is the next call. Resume there instead of starting again.
   **Keep the in-host MCP App present:** successful Project calls check recent App display reports.
   When a receipt supplies `show_gil_monitor(scope_id)` because the Monitor is absent/hidden/unknown,
   call it once before further work, without asking the user to open a Companion. For an explicit
   display check use `gil_monitor_status(project_root)`; if `should_open` is true, prepare that root
   and show the returned scope. `opening` is a 30-second grace, not proof of display: continue without
   polling in a tight loop. Fresh `visible` reports (15-second lease) distinguish fullscreen/inline;
   preserve an inline choice. Two unanswered show requests stop automatic attempts (`unconfirmed`):
   report the display problem instead of adding cards indefinitely. A fresh visible report resets
   that retry budget. Status covers this Project on this MCP connection. If a Host shares that
   connection across chats, it cannot identify which chat contains the App. App reports do not prove
   OS foreground visibility or that the human has looked.
2. **Agree, then finish Interview.** Interview clarifies and agrees scope; it never researches,
   calculates or writes deliverables. Synthesis waits for the user's reply to its proposed statement;
   silence, earlier requests and the agent's own judgment are not approval. Do not ask again for
   approval already given to that exact proposal. Outcome judges the approved scope; do not leave it
   open until the whole project is finished. Choose the next call from the **current recorded state**,
   not from the beginning of the sequence:

   | Current state | Next call |
   | --- | --- |
   | New project, Monitor shown, no step open | `gil_open` Question with its action contract |
   | Question is open | Ask the user, end the turn, then `gil_close` with their actual response |
   | Interpretation is open | `gil_close` with what is settled and what is unresolved |
   | Synthesis is open and the user has not answered | Show the statement, end the turn and wait; no research, no deliverable |
   | Synthesis is open and the user approved its statement | `gil_close` with `approved: yes` (approved-plan profile: the exact `close_report`) |
   | Synthesis is open and the user declined | `gil_close` with `approved: no`, then `gil_open` Question |
   | Synthesis is closed and Outcome has not been opened | `gil_open` Outcome |
   | Outcome is open and its verdict/next direction are ready | `gil_close` Outcome; do not open it again |
   | Outcome is closed but the Interview Cycle is still open | `gil_close` with the Cycle Report; there is no extra Report step to open |
   | Interview Cycle is closed and the agreed execution work remains | `gil_open` Experiment; never `gil_start` an existing project |

If the Companion is installed but closed, start it and resume once its handshake answers. Never installs anything.

tools.description: Open one GIL manual topic, or the topic that fits the current place. Runs the GIL core bundled with this plugin; never a global or repository build.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the GIL project to act on. The host-verified workspace root, or a path the user named. It is never guessed.

tools.name: gil_start
tools.title: Start a GIL project
tools.description: Development image-report creation: creates format 5 (format 7 with Chain in chain-core builds) on verified private storage (macOS Apple Silicon; Windows private app data). Requires the user's explicitly selected absolute project_root. On Windows the working folder may remain in OneDrive: GIL records are kept separately under the current user's local app data, while file observation still targets project_root. An existing inline Windows record is copied byte-for-byte to that private store and verified before publication; the inline source is never changed or deleted. Success commits one Interview, zero Steps; does not open or confirm the Monitor. Unsupported platforms refuse, never fall back to format 4. Migrating existing format-4 records stays macOS-only. Start also prepares the Monitor; follow the returned show_gil_monitor call immediately, before the first gil_open. Never repeat start after display failure.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the GIL project to act on. The host-verified workspace root, or a path the user named. It is never guessed.

tools.name: gil_open
tools.title: Open the next GIL step
tools.description: Open the next step with its action contract on stdin, or open a Cycle of the given kind. GIL decides which applies. Runs the GIL core bundled with this plugin; never a global or repository build. Choose one independently checkable objective and observable done_when. Perform it, then gil_close before another objective. Interview agrees scope only; research, calculations, chat-only reports, implementation and tests belong to Experiment Verify. An Interview Outcome judges the approved scope, not completion of the whole project.

contract.description: Body text passed to GIL on stdin, exactly as written. GIL validates it.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the GIL project to act on. The host-verified workspace root, or a path the user named. It is never guessed.

tools.name: gil_close
tools.title: Close the current GIL step
tools.description: Close the current Report. Two input shapes only. Ordinary close {project_root, report}: every step of a format-4 project (including its Verify), and format-5 non-Verify steps that cite no stored images. Typed close {project_root, report, expected_owner:{kind,ref}, visuals:{attachments,uses,declaration}} with expected_owner and visuals ALWAYS together: every format-5 Verify (with attachments/uses and declaration attached, or empty arrays and declaration not_needed (reason) / missing (reason, follow_up) when there are no images), and any format-5 non-Verify step or Cycle report that cites stored images (uses with source kind stored, empty attachments, no declaration). Sending expected_owner without visuals, or visuals without expected_owner, is rejected with -32602 naming the missing field; that call is not executed and nothing is closed — read gil_status/gil_context for the actual open step, then send one corrected call. After an uncertain or lost response use gil_report_visuals; never automatically repeat close. Every Verify also requires evidence_files in report: 1–32 unique project-relative paths, all nonempty files in its Snapshot, at least one new or changed. No-image declarations do not waive file evidence. Analysis interpretation and Outcome lesson must be nonblank; Core links their actual evidence lineage. No migration. Call when done_when is met. Verify additionally requires actual saved evidence: Report.evidence_files lists project-relative paths, one per line. All must be nonempty Snapshot files; at least one must be new or changed. Chat-only results and visual not_needed/missing do not waive this. Analysis requires a nonblank interpretation; Outcome a nonblank lesson. Core links them to their actual evidence lineage. Follow the next receipt before more work.

report.description: Original Report body; never interpreted as attachment instructions.

tools.name: gil_restore
tools.title: Restore the GIL world
tools.description: Return the working tree to the world this place was opened from. Runs the GIL core bundled with this plugin; never a global or repository build.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the GIL project to act on. The host-verified workspace root, or a path the user named. It is never guessed.

tools.name: gil_revisit
tools.title: Revisit after a failure
tools.description: Go back to the Cycle the closing Report already settled on. Runs the GIL core bundled with this plugin; never a global or repository build.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the GIL project to act on. The host-verified workspace root, or a path the user named. It is never guessed.

tools.name: gil_cycle
tools.title: Legacy GIL cycle helper
tools.description: Legacy helper: do NOT use action=close; this tool cannot accept a Report. Close both Steps and Cycles with gil_close(project_root, report). Use gil_open for new Cycles.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the GIL project to act on. The host-verified workspace root, or a path the user named. It is never guessed.

tools.name: gil_monitor_prepare
tools.description: Prepare the read-only GIL Monitor for an explicitly selected project root and remember that choice in local GIL settings for automatic restart recovery. Then call show_gil_monitor with the returned scope_id. Never guess the root. Does not display an App or write the project.

tools.name: show_gil_monitor
tools.title: GIL Monitor
tools.description: Show the GIL MCP App for a prepared scope. It defaults to horizontal layout and requests fullscreen when ready and supported, with a few bounded retries and then the user's first click inside the App; if it stays inline, the user can click 모니터 펼치기. A returned View is not proof of display or persistent success. Keep the native Companion fallback available.

tools.name: gil_monitor_read
tools.description: Read canonical GIL Monitor data. No write, recovery, path or layout operation.

tools.name: gil_monitor_detail
tools.description: Read canonical GIL Monitor data. No write, recovery, path or layout operation.

tools.name: gil_monitor_poll
tools.description: Read a change hint and renew the watch lease. App-only optional instance_id, presentation and sequence report ephemeral display observations; all three must travel together. Reads and watching alone never prove visibility.

tools.name: gil_monitor_status
tools.description: Check this MCP connection’s recent App display report for the selected Project. No Project writes or native Companion lookup. If should_open is true, call gil_monitor_prepare then show_gil_monitor once. Opening is a bounded grace period, not display proof. Unknown includes expired signals and server restarts.

tools.name: gil_report_visuals
tools.description: Read confirmation, canonical report-field digest and visual reference metadata for one Report in an explicit project. No image bytes, file changes or recovery. Use after an uncertain visual close and to reuse stored assets; confirmed does not prove a particular caller performed the close or that a screen was displayed.

project_root.description: Exact absolute project root explicitly selected by the user.

tools.name: gil_migration_check
tools.description: Read-only development format-4 migration preflight. Explicit canonical root only. No recovery or writes. Synthetic macOS arm64 local projects only.

tools.name: gil_migration_prepare
tools.description: After the human approves copying this project to this new private local backup_root, prepare backup, candidate and independent restoration checks. Does not apply. Report plan and ask separately for apply approval. Never repeat automatically.

tools.name: gil_migration_apply
tools.description: Only after showing the preparation result and receiving fresh human approval for this exact project, backup and plan: apply format 5. apply_approved is the Agent's assertion, not authentication. Preserve remnants on failure; read gil_migration_status, never automatically repeat or roll back.

tools.name: gil_migration_status
tools.description: Read-only migration state and whole-tree preservation against an explicit plan. After lost apply response use this, not apply. Changed records may be legitimate later work; preserve all. No recovery or cleanup.

tools.name: gil_plan_propose
tools.description: Propose the complete scope and ordered experiment checklist in an OPEN Interview Synthesis. No file creation. Wait for the user's Monitor button; chat approval is insufficient. Then gil_plan_read and close Synthesis, Outcome and Interview before execution.

synthesis.description: Complete Synthesis Report fields, including statement, basis_refs and exploration_checklist (item IDs, one per line in order); omit approved, plan_revision, plan_digest.

tools.name: gil_plan_request_interview
tools.description: Preserve a scope-change request during an Experiment. Does not close anything, open another Cycle or approve scope. Finish the current Cycle truthfully, then open a new Interview. Never fabricate evidence to escape an unfinished Step.

tools.name: gil_plan_read
tools.description: Read proposal/Monitor decision and exact close_report. Use close_report unchanged with gil_close. In Experiment, save document verbatim to a file during Verify; name plan_document and separate evidence_files. Never invent approval.

tools.name: gil_plan_review
tools.description: App-only: read exact proposal and private ephemeral approval capability. Never implies user approval.

tools.name: gil_plan_decide
tools.description: App-only: submit explicit trusted Monitor button input for the displayed scope, revision and digest. Requires the private capability from review.

content.text: GIL 진행: Synthesis를 열었다. 제안 statement를 사용자에게 보여 주고 턴을 끝내 답을 기다린다(승인 계획 프로필이면 먼저 gil_plan_propose로 제안하고 Monitor 버튼을 기다린다). 명시적 동의가 있을 때만 gil_close한다. 침묵·이전 요청·자체 판단은 승인이 아니다. 기다리는 동안 조사·보고서 작성을 하지 않는다.

열었다: step:C1/S3 · synthesis

지금 할 일
  제안을 Monitor로 보낸다

완료 조건
  Monitor 응답을 받았다

진행 경계
  이 완료 조건을 충족하면 실제 결과를 Report로 적어 닫고 다음 행동으로 간다.
  다른 목적의 일을 이 노드에 계속 붙이거나, 나중에 기록을 몰아 채우지 않는다.
  이 단계에서는 산출물을 수정하지 않는다. 새 근거를 얻는 외부 자료 조회·측정·계산·원고 작성·구현·테스트는 Verify에서 수행한다. 이미 관측한 자료의 해석은 Analysis에서 한다.
  Interview는 목표·범위를 합의하는 자리다. 본격적인 웹 조사와 보고서 작성은 채팅으로만 전달하더라도 실행 작업이다. Interview를 닫은 뒤 Experiment의 Verify에서 수행한다.
  제안에 대한 사용자의 답을 기다린다. 이미 그 제안에 동의했다면 다시 묻거나 작업을 시작하지 말고, 실제 승인을 Report에 기록해 이 Synthesis를 닫는다. 이후 영수증에 따라 Outcome을 열고 닫은 다음 Interview Cycle Report를 별도로 닫는다.

닫을 때 필요한 것
  statement
  basis_refs

  approved
    yes — 사람이 이 제안을 승인했다 — 다음 자리는 판정(outcome)뿐이다
    no — 사람이 승인하지 않았다 — 왜 아닌지 다시 묻는다(question)

content.text: GIL 거절: 닫힌 것은 없다. 아래 이유의 입력 오류를 고쳐 같은 gil_close를 한 번 다시 보낸다. 위치가 불확실하면 먼저 gil_status를 읽는다. 다른 단계를 건너뛰거나 기록을 몰아 채우지 않는다.

거절: step:C1/S3 · synthesis 를 닫을 수 없다.

이유
  승인 계획: gil_plan_propose로 제안한 뒤 Monitor 버튼 응답을 기다린다

지금 해야 할 일
  아래 꼴로 다시 적는다 — 어떤 값을 적을 수 있는지는 `gil close --help`.

    gil close <<'EOF'   # step:C1/S3 · synthesis
    statement: …
    basis_refs: …
    approved: …
    EOF
  Chain 종료 제안이라면 chain_verdict: success 또는 failure를 함께 적는다. 탐색 경로·실패·남은 질문을 사용자에게 설명하고 실제 동의를 받은 경우에만 approved: yes를 적는다. 동의를 추측하지 않는다. 일반 계획 합의에는 chain_verdict를 넣지 않는다.

실행
  gil close

## GIL shared workflow

These rules apply to every GIL connection, with or without a Plugin, on every operating system.
Use only the user's selected absolute `project_root`. Each receipt's text guidance names **one next
call or one wait**; do it, then read the next receipt. Read `structuredContent` too, and follow the
actual recorded position and the connected tool schema. Never repeat a call that already succeeded.

1. **Start and show.** Start a new project once. After successful `gil_start`, follow its returned
   `show_gil_monitor` call before opening the first Interview step. Do not prepare the Monitor again
   if start returned its scope. Never repeat start to open a screen. If start succeeded but Monitor
   preparation failed, report the display failure and continue the recorded Interview via `gil_open`.
   A display failure alone does not block Project work. A successful tool response does not prove
   that a screen is visible. In a new session, read `gil_context` once; its first block
   `[지금 바로 할 호출]` is the next call. Resume there instead of starting again.
   **Keep the in-host MCP App present:** successful Project calls check recent App display reports.
   When a receipt supplies `show_gil_monitor(scope_id)` because the Monitor is absent/hidden/unknown,
   call it once before further work, without asking the user to open a Companion. For an explicit
   display check use `gil_monitor_status(project_root)`; if `should_open` is true, prepare that root
   and show the returned scope. `opening` is a 30-second grace, not proof of display: continue without
   polling in a tight loop. Fresh `visible` reports (15-second lease) distinguish fullscreen/inline;
   preserve an inline choice. Two unanswered show requests stop automatic attempts (`unconfirmed`):
   report the display problem instead of adding cards indefinitely. A fresh visible report resets
   that retry budget. Status covers this Project on this MCP connection. If a Host shares that
   connection across chats, it cannot identify which chat contains the App. App reports do not prove
   OS foreground visibility or that the human has looked.
2. **Agree, then finish Interview.** Interview clarifies and agrees scope; it never researches,
   calculates or writes deliverables. Synthesis waits for the user's reply to its proposed statement;
   silence, earlier requests and the agent's own judgment are not approval. Do not ask again for
   approval already given to that exact proposal. Outcome judges the approved scope; do not leave it
   open until the whole project is finished. Choose the next call from the **current recorded state**,
   not from the beginning of the sequence:

   | Current state | Next call |
   | --- | --- |
   | New project, Monitor shown, no step open | `gil_open` Question with its action contract |
   | Question is open | Ask the user, end the turn, then `gil_close` with their actual response |
   | Interpretation is open | `gil_close` with what is settled and what is unresolved |
   | Synthesis is open and the user has not answered | Show the statement, end the turn and wait; no research, no deliverable |
   | Synthesis is open and the user approved its statement | `gil_close` with `approved: yes` (approved-plan profile: the exact `close_report`) |
   | Synthesis is open and the user declined | `gil_close` with `approved: no`, then `gil_open` Question |
   | Synthesis is closed and Outcome has not been opened | `gil_open` Outcome |
   | Outcome is open and its verdict/next direction are ready | `gil_close` Outcome; do not open it again |
   | Outcome is closed but the Interview Cycle is still open | `gil_close` with the Cycle Report; there is no extra Report step to open |
   | Interview Cycle is closed and the agreed execution work remains | `gil_open` Experiment; never `gil_start` an existing project |

    gil close <<'EOF'   # step:C1/S3 · synthesis
    statement: …
    basis_refs: …
    approved: …
    EOF

  이미지가 필요 없는 문서 증거라면 visuals: {"attachments":[],"uses":[],"declaration":{"state":"not_needed","reason":"이미지가 필요 없는 실제 이유"}}

  result

  project_root와 report(실제 execution/result/evidence_files)에 다음 두 인자를 함께 보낸다:
  expected_owner: {"kind":"step","ref":"step:C3/S3"}
  이미지가 필요 없는 문서 증거라면 visuals: {"attachments":[],"uses":[],"declaration":{"state":"not_needed","reason":"이미지가 필요 없는 실제 이유"}}
  이미지를 남긴 경우 연결된 스키마의 attachments/uses와 attached 선언을 쓴다. 별도 시각 보고 도구를 찾거나 일반 close를 반복하지 않는다.
  증거 필수: 실제 관측·실행 결과를 프로젝트의 문서·로그·데이터·코드·시각자료 파일로 저장한다. 읽기만 한 작업도 관측 문서를 남긴다. Report의 evidence_files에 상대 경로를 한 줄에 하나씩 적는다. 파일 없음·빈 파일·이전 파일만 그대로 재사용하면 서버가 닫기를 거절한다. 채팅이나 visuals.not_needed/missing으로 대체할 수 없다.
  이 Verify 계약 안의 조사·출처 확인·계산·보고서 작성·구현·테스트를 수행한다. 관측을 마치기 전에 닫지 않는다. 완료 뒤에는 닫고 Analysis로 결과를 해석한다.

닫을 때 필요한 것
  execution
  result

content.text: GIL 거절: 닫힌 것은 없다. 아래 이유의 입력 오류를 고쳐 같은 gil_close를 한 번 다시 보낸다. 위치가 불확실하면 먼저 gil_status를 읽는다. 다른 단계를 건너뛰거나 기록을 몰아 채우지 않는다.

거절: step:C4/S3 · synthesis 를 닫을 수 없다.

이유
  승인 계획: 승인한 내용 그대로 닫는다. gil_plan_read의 close_report를 사용한다

지금 해야 할 일
  아래 꼴로 다시 적는다 — 어떤 값을 적을 수 있는지는 `gil close --help`.

    gil close <<'EOF'   # step:C4/S3 · synthesis
    statement: …
    basis_refs: …
    approved: …
    EOF
  Chain 종료 제안이라면 chain_verdict: success 또는 failure를 함께 적는다. 탐색 경로·실패·남은 질문을 사용자에게 설명하고 실제 동의를 받은 경우에만 approved: yes를 적는다. 동의를 추측하지 않는다. 일반 계획 합의에는 chain_verdict를 넣지 않는다.

실행
  gil close

열었다: step:C4/S7 · outcome

지금 할 일
  승인 제안으로 방향을 정한다

완료 조건
  판정과 방향이 정해졌다

진행 경계
  이 완료 조건을 충족하면 실제 결과를 Report로 적어 닫고 다음 행동으로 간다.
  다른 목적의 일을 이 노드에 계속 붙이거나, 나중에 기록을 몰아 채우지 않는다.
  이 단계에서는 산출물을 수정하지 않는다. 새 근거를 얻는 외부 자료 조회·측정·계산·원고 작성·구현·테스트는 Verify에서 수행한다. 이미 관측한 자료의 해석은 Analysis에서 한다.
  Interview는 목표·범위를 합의하는 자리다. 본격적인 웹 조사와 보고서 작성은 채팅으로만 전달하더라도 실행 작업이다. Interview를 닫은 뒤 Experiment의 Verify에서 수행한다.
  이 Outcome은 승인된 목표에 대한 판정이다. 프로젝트 전체 실행이 끝날 때까지 열어 두지 않는다. 판정과 다음 방향이 정해지면 이 Step을 닫고, 이어 Interview Cycle Report를 별도로 닫는다.

GIL 진행: Synthesis를 열었다. 제안 statement를 사용자에게 보여 주고 턴을 끝내 답을 기다린다(승인 계획 프로필이면 먼저 gil_plan_propose로 제안하고 Monitor 버튼을 기다린다). 명시적 동의가 있을 때만 gil_close한다. 침묵·이전 요청·자체 판단은 승인이 아니다. 기다리는 동안 조사·보고서 작성을 하지 않는다.

열었다: step:C7/S3 · synthesis

지금 할 일
  제안을 Monitor로 보낸다

완료 조건
  Monitor 응답을 받았다

진행 경계
  이 완료 조건을 충족하면 실제 결과를 Report로 적어 닫고 다음 행동으로 간다.
  다른 목적의 일을 이 노드에 계속 붙이거나, 나중에 기록을 몰아 채우지 않는다.
  이 단계에서는 산출물을 수정하지 않는다. 새 근거를 얻는 외부 자료 조회·측정·계산·원고 작성·구현·테스트는 Verify에서 수행한다. 이미 관측한 자료의 해석은 Analysis에서 한다.
  Interview는 목표·범위를 합의하는 자리다. 본격적인 웹 조사와 보고서 작성은 채팅으로만 전달하더라도 실행 작업이다. Interview를 닫은 뒤 Experiment의 Verify에서 수행한다.
  제안에 대한 사용자의 답을 기다린다. 이미 그 제안에 동의했다면 다시 묻거나 작업을 시작하지 말고, 실제 승인을 Report에 기록해 이 Synthesis를 닫는다. 이후 영수증에 따라 Outcome을 열고 닫은 다음 Interview Cycle Report를 별도로 닫는다.

  statement
  basis_refs

    yes — 사람이 이 제안을 승인했다 — 다음 자리는 판정(outcome)뿐이다
    no — 사람이 승인하지 않았다 — 왜 아닌지 다시 묻는다(question)
